Profile

Ryoji Sato is Associate Professor at the University Education Center, Tokyo Metropolitan University. He works in philosophy and ethics, mainly in the philosophy of mind, the philosophy of cognitive science and applied ethics. Alongside his research, he teaches students to read, write and argue in English and to think critically.
